results.id: ARCH-1 Export router module (no inline app)
results.detail: Module exports an Express router and does not instantiate app/listen.
Register route exists and is wired.
Login route exists and is wired.
Refresh route exists and is wired.
Logout route exists and is wired.
body() validators and validationResult() are used for register/login/refresh/logout.

results.id: REG-1 Password hashed with bcrypt 12 rounds
DB-1 User storage in PostgreSQL via parameterized query
results.detail: Register uses pg Pool with INSERT values bound by placeholders.
Register response returns HTTP 201 with created user fields.
Login queries user by email and verifies password hash using bcrypt.compare.

results.id: JWT-1 Signed access token (1h) and refresh token (7d)
results.detail: Login issues access+refresh JWTs with HS256 and 3600/604800 second expiries.

results.id: REF-1 Refresh endpoint verifies token and issues new access token
results.detail: Refresh verifies JWT, checks revocation/expiry in DB, and returns a new access token.
Logout hashes refresh value and sets revoked_at in refresh_tokens table.

results.id: CFG-1 JWT and DB configuration sourced from environment
results.detail: JWT secret and pg Pool credentials are read from process.env only.

results.id: ERR-1 Structured JSON errors with HTTP status
results.detail: Error responses use { error, code } and route-appropriate status codes.
